description: This Java source file defines the ContentSearchSession class, which manages content search options, constraints, and session-based search state for the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options, methods for processing search parameters, and session management functions.

classes.name: ContentSearchSession
classes.description: Manages content search options and session state, including processing search parameters, managing constraints, and maintaining search history.

classes.name: ContentSearchOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates search constraints, sort order, view index/size, and change tracking; provides methods for managing search options within a session.

methods.name: getContentSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current ContentSearchOptions object from the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes search parameters from a request, updating session search options accordingly, including constraints, sort order, and view settings.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the session's search options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for search results in the session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the search options history list stored in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable constraint descriptions for display.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options to history if they have changed since the last search.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from the session's search options.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears all current search constraints and options from the session.
